name: Camped Out
overview: Netflix’s upcoming series “Camped Out” revolves around three “teenage slackers” who escape repeating a year of high school by agreeing to work at their guidance counsellor’s “financially strapped” summer camp, according to the CBC synopsis.  While there, they provide young campers with bad advice, terrible survival skills, and “abysmal role models,” focusing less on the kids and more on “their own attempts to make the summer not suck, avoid work, and wreak havoc,” all on a luxury yacht club situated across the lake.
